title: 美国零售意外大跌：美联储按兵不动，降息预期升温
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Well retail sales data are disappointing we thought they might be a little bit lower and they're a lot bit lower retail sales on a headline basis. Down by six tenths of a percent the forecast was for a one-tenth percent rise.
segments.zh: 零售销售数据令人失望，我们原本预期会略低，但实际低得多。总体零售销售下降0.6%，而预期为上升0.1%。

segments.en: Retail sales ex-auto down three tenths, raise sales ex-auto and gas down two tenths. Now of course gasoline prices were lower during the month.
segments.zh: 扣除汽车的零售销售下降0.3%，扣除汽车和汽油的销售下降0.2%。当然，当月汽油价格有所下跌。

segments.en: And retail sales control the part that goes into GDP the part that economists tend to watch is down by four tenths it was up by half a percent last month at least on an un revised basis.
segments.zh: 零售销售控制组，即计入GDP的部分，经济学家关注的部分，下降了0.4%，而前一个月未经修正的数据为上升0.5%。

segments.en: So we're going to have to check into see what where the week this is in this but it's definitely a disappointing report and it may add to some of the do not raise rates thoughts that people are having on Wall Street right now.
segments.zh: 所以我们需要进一步核实数据，但这无疑是一份令人失望的报告，可能加剧华尔街对于不加息的预期。

segments.en: Yeah Mike I'll let you dig through some of the details and just give you a read of markets you can see equity futures still positive pretty much across the board you are seeing not necessarily some sort of read through in terms of negativity.
segments.zh: 是的，Mike，你来分析细节，我来说说市场反应。可以看到股指期货仍然普遍上涨，并没有出现负面解读。

segments.en: In fact if anything a more positive up a tenth of a percent in the S&P futures NASDAQ up a quarter percent Russell 2000 now turning just marginally positive.
segments.zh: 实际上，标普500期货上涨0.1%，纳斯达克期货上涨0.25%，罗素2000期货也转为小幅上涨。

segments.en: 2010s and 30s a little bit more interesting as Mike was saying giving a little bit more heft the idea that this Fed can remain on hold.
segments.zh: 10年期和30年期国债收益率更有意思，正如Mike所说，这增加了美联储维持利率不变的可能性。

segments.en: Now we're looking at that two-year yield lower by four basis points 4.099% we are we going to see these yields fall below 4% once again before that September meeting 10-year yields lower by almost two basis points 4.63%.
segments.zh: 现在两年期收益率下降4个基点至4.099%，我们是否会看到收益率在9月会议前再次跌破4%？10年期收益率下降近2个基点至4.63%。
